findings.evidence: `Cube.boundary N` is `{y | ∃ i, y i = 0 ∨ y i = 1}` (Mathlib HomotopyGroup.lean:58), hence it is empty for `N = Empty`; Mathlib Connected/Basic.lean:70 proves `isPreconnected_empty`.
findings.fix: Replace “exactly when” with the sufficient claim “when the index type has at least two elements,” or explicitly qualify the characterization to positive dimensions.
findings.issue: The module docstring falsely says the cube boundary is preconnected exactly when the index type has at least two elements; for an empty index type the boundary is empty and therefore preconnected.

findings.evidence: Lines 173–175 declare `(n : ℕ) : π_ (n + 2) E e ≃* π_ (n + 2) X (p e)`.
findings.fix: Say that it induces `π_(n + 2)(E,e) ≃* π_(n + 2)(X,p e)` for every `n : ℕ`, or rename the prose variable when stating the equivalent `m ≥ 2` formulation.
findings.issue: The declaration docstring reuses `n` inconsistently: it claims an isomorphism on `π_n` for `n ≥ 2`, but the declaration accepts every `n : ℕ` and returns an isomorphism on `π_(n + 2)`. For example, argument `2` selects `π_4`, not `π_2`.

summary: Two documentation claims are inaccurate and should be corrected to match the indexed dimensions.
